segments.en_txt: Regarding the reanalysis (reproduction) of statistical analysis results:

segments.ko_txt: - 결과보고서 본문에 제시된 일차 및 이차 유효성 평가변수의 분석결과 전체에 대하여 재분석을 실시하였으며 재분석의 결과가 결과보고서의 내용과 일치함을 확인하여 분석이 계획된 방법에 따라 적절히 수행되었는지를 확인해보았으며, 각 평가변수별 결과보고서와 재분석 결과는 아래에 각 평가변수별로 제시하였음.
segments.en_txt: All results for the primary and secondary efficacy endpoints outlined throughout the clinical study report have been reanalyzed. It was confirmed that these reanalysis results were consistent with the findings presented in the original clinical study report and that the analysis was conducted appropriately according to the planned methods. The clinical study report and reanalysis results for each endpoint are presented below.

segments.ko_txt: - 통계분석 방법은 일차 유효성 평가변수의 경우 Low cohort와 High cohort 각각에서 대조군 대비 시험군의 우월성을 층화요인(예정된 시술과 관련된 출혈 위험)을 보정한 Cochran- Mantel-Haenszel test를 통해 유의수준 0.05에서 비교하였음. 본 임상시험의 성공은 2개의 Cohort 모두에서 우월성을 입증하는 것으로 계획하였음. 이차 유효성 평가변수의 경우 범주형 변수의 경우 일차 유효성 평가변수와 동일한 방법으로 비교하였고, 연속형 변수의 경우 Wilcoxon rank sum test를 통해 분석을 실시하였음.
segments.en_txt: For the primary efficacy endpoint, the statistical analysis method involved testing the superiority of the test group over the control group in each of the low and high cohorts using the Cochran–Mantel–Haenszel test, adjusted for stratification factors (risk of bleeding associated with the scheduled procedure), with a significance level of α=0.05.The success of this clinical trial was designed to demonstrate superiority in both cohorts. For secondary efficacy endpoints, categorical variables were analyzed using the same method as for the primary endpoint, and continuous variables were analyzed using the Wilcoxon rank-sum test.

segments.en_txt: All results for the primary and secondary efficacy endpoints outlined throughout the clinical study report have been reanalyzed. It was confirmed that these reanalysis results were consistent with the findings presented in the original clinical study report and that the analysis was conducted appropriately according to the planned methods. The clinical study report and reanalysis results for each endpoint are presented below.

segments.ko_txt: 통계분석 방법은 일차 유효성 평가변수의 경우 Low cohort와 High cohort 각각에서 대조군 대비 시험군의 우월성을 층화요인(예정된 시술과 관련된 출혈 위험)을 보정한 Cochran- Mantel-Haenszel test를 통해 유의수준 0.05에서 비교하였음.
segments.en_txt: For the primary efficacy endpoint, the statistical analysis method involved testing the superiority of the test group over the control group in each of the low and high cohorts using the Cochran–Mantel–Haenszel test, adjusted for stratification factors (risk of bleeding associated with the scheduled procedure), with a significance level of α=0.05.

segments.en_txt: The success of this clinical trial was designed to demonstrate superiority in both cohorts.
